game.name: Battlefield : Bad Company (Europe)(Gold Edition)
game.desc: Battlefield: Bad Company on Xbox 360 takes us back to the warlike world of Battlefield, immersing us in a group of deserters. The player has almost total freedom, and must make his place among the commando of four soldiers to which he belongs. A multiplayer mode is of course present, so you can play this FPS with many other aficionados of the genre.
